name: get_alert
description: Use this as the primary tool to get information about a specific alert. An alert is the representation of a violation of an alert policy. This is useful for understanding the details of a specific alert.

name.description: Required. The name of the alert. The format is: projects/[PROJECT_ID_OR_NUMBER]/alerts/[ALERT_ID] The `[ALERT_ID]` is a system-assigned unique identifier for the alert.
